description: Change of use from Use Class C3 (dwelling house) to Use Class Sui Generis (HMO-house in multiple occupation) (RETROSPECTIVE).
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:L101, E101, E102, E103, E104, SuDS proforma, Design & Access Statement, CIL from, Flood Risk Assessment & Highway Safety Impact formReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than seven residents at any one time without first obtaining the approval, in writing, of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building does not adversely affect the adjoining premises/immediate

Waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site should be provided within the development, in accordance with the Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). Such facilities to be retained permanently thereafter.Reason: In order to facilitate efficient, safe and clean removal of household refuse, the location and accessibility of refuse storage plus to maintain safety on the Highway.

Unless within one month of the date of this decision, a Verification Report demonstrating that drainage measures have been fully implemented is submitted in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval, the use of the development shall cease until such time as a Verification Report has been approved and the measures verified as implemented.The Verification Report shall include:a) as-built drawings of the sustainable drainage systems including level information;b) photographs of the completed sustainable drainage systems;c) any relevant certificates from manufacturers/suppliers of drainage features; andd) a confirmation statement of the above signed by a chartered engineer.If no Verification Report in accordance with this condition is approved within four months of the date of this decision, the use of the development shall cease until such time as a Verification Report approved by the Local Planning Authority has been approved and the measures verified as implemented.In the event of a legal challenge to this decision, or to a decision made pursuant to the procedure set out in this condition, the operation of the time limits specified in this condition shall be suspended until that legal challenge has been finally determined.REASON : To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD 59-62, and Policies SI12 & SI13 of the London Plan and the NPPF

No cooking facilities, including hot plates, shall be installed in the bedrooms of the development hereby permitted unless details have first been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Any cooking facilities shall thereafter only be implemented in accordance with the details that have been approved pursuant to this condition.Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.
